summaries.en: As President Trump calls for participation in a Hormuz escort coalition and US forces in Japan are redeployed to Iran, Japan faces deepening concerns ahead of the upcoming US-Japan summit.
summaries.zh: 随着特朗普总统呼吁加入霍尔木兹护航联盟，以及驻日美军被派往伊朗，日本在美国-日本峰会前夕面临日益加深的担忧。
